_comment: Known sites of the decision guards in Tests/Verbara.Sdk.Governance.Tests that fired on a defect already owned elsewhere when the guard landed. Each entry is {guard, path, key, reason, owner}: key is the whitespace-normalized text of the site (never a line number) and owner names the change that owns the fix. The match is EXACT: a site not listed fails its guard, and an entry whose site no longer fires fails it too, so the change that fixes a site deletes its entry in the same commit. Never add an entry to let a new violation in.

entries.reason: Each consume loop is handed to Task.Run gated on the bridge's stopping token (ADR-0058 R2). No observable effect: a skipped consume loop and one that ends at its first check both do nothing. The fix passes CancellationToken.None and deletes this entry.

FillPipeAsync swallows an IOException from the socket read, so a network reset and a normal hangup produce the same Connected > Disconnected sequence with no log and no metric (ADR-0053 R3; CodeQL #867). The fix logs and counts the reset, keeping the ending a consumer sees, and deletes this entry. It shares its key with the ReadPumpAsync entry, so the matcher counts two occurrences and cannot tell which one went stale: delete the entry whose reason names the method you fixed.

ReadPumpAsync swallows an IOException from the input pipe. FillPipeAsync completes the pipe writer without an exception, so this catch is not reached today (CodeQL #869) and needs a fix of its own; the entry stays with this owner until another is assigned. It shares its key with the FillPipeAsync entry: delete the entry whose reason names the method you fixed.

StartAsync links the start token into _cts, the source the sweep loop runs under (ADR-0059 R2: not stored, and not linked either). StopAsync cancels _cts itself, so the loop does end on a stop; the link adds only the coupling R2 rejects, an aborted start ending the sweep. Whether R2 reaches a service that links the start token for its own loop, rather than handing a lifetime token to another component, is open ruling L1 of the 2026-09-26 ADR audit, and this entry waits on it: if R2 applies, the fix owns a plain source and deletes this entry.
entries.owner: owner ruling L1 (the scope of ADR-0059 R2), not yet ruled
